frozen_frontier.source: the exact R48E/R47X center plus one-swap frontier

width_policy.producer: frozen R47M exact-DP plus full existing-stack closure
width_policy.eligible: verified terminal OR strict variable decrease with no fresh variables
width_policy.nonterminal_acceptance: eligible and normalized persisted successor max clause width <=4
width_policy.obstruction: No terminal and no eligible normalized successor with persisted width<=4 after independently replaying every produced candidate.

proof_carrying_integrity: reproduce R48O sealed root/path exactly before frontier continuation
every selected candidate full R47M independent replay PASS
every selected nonterminal successor strict variable decrease, no fresh variables, max width<=4
every obstruction claim independently replays all produced candidates
every SAT terminal reconstructs through the entire selected chain and verifies its reachable root
